tools.name: mcp_discover
tools.description: Search tool catalogs across connected child MCP servers and list server status without exposing every child tool schema up front.

tools.name: mcp_provision
tools.description: Resolve an intent to configured or registry-discovered MCP servers and suggest safe provisioning paths.

tools.name: mcp_call
tools.description: Forward a tool call to a specific child MCP server with lifecycle management, retries, secret scrubbing, and ledger evidence.

tools.name: mcp_execute
tools.description: Run JavaScript in a constrained V8 sandbox with access to provisioned MCP servers for multi-step workflows.

tools.name: mcp_skill_discover
tools.description: Search local agent skills and report whether their companion MCP servers are configured and ready.

tools.name: mcp_skill_advise
tools.description: Perform a pre-flight readiness check for a named skill and recommend missing MCP server configuration.
